Here is a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan for your parents, with easy mornings and a break after lunch each day.

Day 1, the old city: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning, then lunch nearby. Visit Hawa Mahal in the late afternoon and walk the Johari Bazaar for an evening of shopping and snacks.
Day 2, the forts: Go early to Amber Fort, before the heat and crowds, and take the jeep up instead of the steep walk. After lunch, stop at Jal Mahal for photos, then watch the sunset from Nahargarh Fort.
Day 3, slow and local: Visit Albert Hall Museum and the Birla Mandir in the morning. Keep the afternoon free for Bapu Bazaar, famous for block-print fabrics and juttis, and end with a Rajasthani thali dinner.

Mid-October to February is the best time to visit, with pleasant days. Hire one cab for all three days so there is no hunting for autos, and book a hotel near the old city to cut travel time.
